as_told.title: Herrera suggests the Indonesia program was evacuating after the earthquake

plain: The story goes that in Indonesia, a unit that included a man named Michael Herrera came upon a team of "psionic assets" being evacuated. These were people said to be used for their supposed psychic powers, and they had with them a craft not made by humans. The researcher Matthew Pines raises it on the show as a puzzle he is trying to explain, asking: "How do I create a scenario that explains a psionic asset team with a non-human craft in Indonesia that's witnessed by Michael Herrera?" Michels, passing on what Herrera told him, offers two guesses. It might have been "this like human trafficking psionic asset transfer operation," or a programme was running out there and its people were trying to get out "because the earthquake had hit." If true, it would mean secret programmes were using psychic people alongside non-human technology overseas.
